name: mobile-banking-automation-framework
description: Enterprise-grade mobile automation framework for Android and iOS banking applications using WebdriverIO, Appium 2.x, TypeScript, and Cucumber BDD.

scripts.test:android: cross-env PLATFORM=android ENVIRONMENT=qa npx wdio src/config/wdio.conf.ts
scripts.test:ios: cross-env PLATFORM=ios ENVIRONMENT=qa npx wdio src/config/wdio.conf.ts
scripts.test:m8: cross-env PLATFORM=android ENVIRONMENT=qa npx wdio src/config/wdio.conf.ts --cucumberOpts.tagExpression='@ID-M8'
scripts.test:mobile-features: cross-env PLATFORM=android ENVIRONMENT=qa npx wdio src/config/wdio.conf.ts --cucumberOpts.tagExpression='@mobile'
scripts.test:smoke: cross-env PLATFORM=android ENVIRONMENT=qa npx wdio src/config/wdio.conf.ts --cucumberOpts.tagExpression='@smoke or @critical'
scripts.test:regression: cross-env PLATFORM=android ENVIRONMENT=qa npx wdio src/config/wdio.conf.ts --cucumberOpts.tagExpression='@regression'
scripts.test:parallel: cross-env PLATFORM=android ENVIRONMENT=qa npx wdio src/config/wdio.conf.ts
scripts.report:allure: allure generate reports/allure-results --clean -o reports/allure-report && allure open reports/allure-report
